tool_choice_rationale:
Strategy:
- Unconstrained phase: penalize "<<" to encourage initial reasoning without immediate expressions.
- Constrained phase: adaptively control expression opening/closing using logit manipulation.
- Penalize ">>" when expressions are short to prevent premature closing.
- Boost ">>" when expressions are long to encourage closure.
- Use ConfidenceGatedStep to balance between model quality and grammar enforcement.
